notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic Swamps.
description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Cabal Stronghold's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Cabal Stronghold.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
